full_prompt_en: The image is a square traditional oil portrait of a young man in a broad black hat standing beside a black-and-white dog against a plain brown background. The background has a gentle warm gradient, darker at the upper corners and around the lower edge, with no visible room furnishings. The man occupies the center and right from hat to hips, his body angled slightly toward the viewer while his face looks directly outward. A large soft black hat spreads to both sides above long, dark, loosely curled hair that falls around his cheeks and collar. His face is pale and calm, with dark eyes, a small straight nose, and softly closed lips. A white lace cravat fills the narrow opening at his neck and descends over a dark fitted waistcoat. Rows of small buttons run down the vest, while a nearly black outer coat wraps his shoulders and arms in broad, low-contrast folds. On the right, his elbow bends outward and one pale hand rests at his waist, a frilled white cuff emerging from the dark sleeve. At the lower left, a dog stands close to him, cropped at the body but showing tall dark ears, a white blaze down the face, and a thick pale chest. The dog's dark eyes and nose look forward, making it a small secondary focal point beside the man's hand and face. Warm light enters from the upper left front, softly illuminating the face, lace, hand, and white fur while the hat and coat retain deep brown-black shadows. The paint blends smoothly across skin and background, with finer strokes in hair, lace, and fur and broader strokes in the clothing. The view is nearly frontal and tightly framed, allowing the dark silhouette to merge partly with the warm ground. The overall composition uses a restrained brown and black field to focus attention on the pale face, white textile, and alert dog.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形传统油画肖像，一位戴宽大黑帽的年轻男子与黑白狗站在一起，背景是朴素棕色。背景有柔和暖色渐变，上部两角和底边附近较暗，没有可见室内家具。男子从帽子到臀部占据中央和右侧，身体略转向观者，面孔直接朝外。柔软的大黑帽向两侧展开，深色松卷长发从帽下垂到脸颊和衣领旁。他面色浅而平静，深色眼睛、小而直的鼻子，嘴唇柔和合拢。白色蕾丝领巾填在颈间窄口，并垂到深色合身马甲上。小纽扣成排沿马甲向下，近黑外套把肩膀和手臂包在宽大低反差衣褶里。右侧手肘向外弯，一只浅色手放在腰间，带褶的白袖口从深色袖子里露出。左下角一只狗紧靠他站着，身体被画边裁切，但高高的深色耳朵、贯穿面部的白纹和厚实浅色胸毛清楚可见。狗的深色眼睛和鼻子朝前，使它成为男子的手和脸旁边较小的次要焦点。暖光从左前上方进入，柔和照亮面孔、蕾丝、手和白毛，帽子与外套仍保有深棕黑阴影。颜料在皮肤和背景上平顺混色，在头发、蕾丝和毛发中笔触更细，在衣服上更宽。视点几乎正面且裁切紧凑，使深色剪影部分融入暖底。整体构图以克制的棕黑区域将注意力集中到浅色面孔、白织物和警觉的狗身上。
style_prompt_en: Traditional oil painting uses smooth warm tonal modeling inside a restrained brown and near-black palette. A large dark silhouette occupies the center against a plain, softly graded ground; a few compact cream-white passages give it clear focal structure. Edges merge gently where similar dark values meet, while pale illuminated contours and small decorative details become more exact. Fabrics are handled in broad low-contrast folds, contrasted with finer bristle marks in soft fibrous areas. One warm upper-side light lifts selected surfaces and leaves surrounding recesses in deep colored shadow. The close frontal arrangement has little spatial clutter, so posture-like diagonals and the relation of light to dark carry the balance. The overall effect is quiet, formal, and intimate, with subtle texture within a low-key value range.
style_prompt_zh: 传统油画在克制的棕与近黑配色里使用平顺的暖色明暗塑形。一块宽大深色剪影占据中央，背后是朴素、柔和渐变的底色；少量紧凑奶油白色区域赋予它清楚焦点结构。相近深色明度相接处边缘温柔并合，浅色受光轮廓与小装饰细节则更加准确。布面用宽阔低反差褶面处理，对照柔软纤维区域的较细笔毛痕。单一暖色上侧光提亮选定表面，周围内凹处留在深色的有色阴影中。近距离正面排列没有空间杂物，让姿态般斜线与明暗关系承担平衡。整体效果安静、正式且亲近，在低调明度范围里保留细微肌理。
theme_en: A young man in a broad black hat posing with a black-and-white dog
theme_zh: 一位戴宽大黑帽的年轻男子与黑白狗一同站立
name: Esaias van de Velde
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
